macro.fact: Abu Dhabi residential sales in Q3 2026: AED 21.5bn across 6,085 transactions; volume down 19% QoQ; off-plan 81% of activity (Savills).
Expatriate residents and non-resident foreigners were the top buyer groups in Jan-Jun 2026; leading nationalities include China, India, Russia and the UK (ADREC data).
Foreign buyers from 116 nationalities active in H1 2026, up from 82 a year earlier.
Expatriates and non-resident foreigners made up 62% of residential unit sales in 2025 (ADREC).
Al Reem Island: 4,471 transactions in H1 2026; apartment prices +17.3% YoY (Cavendish Maxwell).
Al Reem Island YTD 2026: median AED 1,704/sqft, +21.2% YoY, 75% of sales off-plan, gross rental yield 5.8%.
Al Reem Island, 12 months to June 2026: 8,725 sales, residential median AED 1,591/sqft (+37.9%).
Property of AED 2M+ is commonly cited as qualifying for the 10-year UAE Golden Visa - a selling point for a 3BR at this price.
macro.type: agency guide - verify with ICP before quoting

resale_rules.finding: Several guides cite 2% of contract value for off-plan (interim register) dispositions on DARI, plus an e-service fee (~AED 400 + VAT). Who pays is set by agreement; one guide says split 50/50.
resale_rules.confidence: Medium - not confirmed on an official ADREC/DARI page (adrec.gov.ae did not respond from this environment)

resale_rules.finding: Developer NOC needed; confirms no arrears and accepts buyer taking over the plan. Guides quote AED 500-5,000 or 1-2% assignment fee for some projects; minimum paid thresholds of 30-40% are common.
resale_rules.confidence: Low-Medium - Radiant's own policy not found publicly; must be obtained from Radiant

resale_rules.finding: AED 950K of AED 3.03M = 31.4% paid. If Radiant requires 30%+ you likely qualify; if it requires 40% you would need ~AED 262K more paid before a NOC.
Market norm 2% of price from each side, plus 5% VAT on the commission. Negotiable, especially for an exclusive.

Buyer pays you the amount you have paid to Radiant plus the agreed premium; buyer takes over the remaining balance with Radiant; the transfer is recorded in the interim register on DARI after the NOC.

capability_notes: Property Finder: public pages read directly (robots.txt-allowed paths only). Primary data source.
Bayut and Dubizzle search pages: bot protection; not bypassed. Data only from web-search snippets, labelled unverified.
Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram, Reddit: need login or not indexed; no posts read. Manual search required.
ADREC / DMT sites: no response from this environment; official fee schedule not confirmed.
No registry (DARI) transaction feed is publicly available; 'claimed' sales come from agent profiles on Property Finder.
